text: I request the implementation of an accessible loading zone to support a family’s access to TTC Wheel-Trans services. The designated space will provide a safe and convenient area for pick-up and drop-off, ensuring improved mobility and accessibility for residents with disabilities. The proposed loading zone will enhance equitable transportation options and contribute to a more inclusive community.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone to be in effect at all times on the west side of Munford Crescent, between a point 20 metres north of Chapman Avenue and a point 7 metres further north.
